title: DSP price calculator — composition stages
summary: Drill-down of “DSP price calculator”: context resolution, price-list matrix, gross, discount and best-price selection roles. Composition stages, decisions and data transformations only; not a call stack or observed runtime behaviour.

sources.note: Lines 31-121: customer must exist, be allowed and match tenant; defaults for division/facility/currency/order type/warehouse; price-list table and discount model from customer; N-MONTER redirected to N-MONTERX; no items/item masters/matrix -> empty.
Lines 196-205 and 351-397: per-tenant gross price list (Dahl prio>=9 then BDBR_9A; Optimera/Flisekompaniet/Monter prio 1; DahlFI prio 9; OptimeraSE first found); gross<=0 -> no price.
Lines 207-299: per price list, campaign/limit prices with per-campaign discounts; line volume-discount limits; keep cheapest per quantity; best net price wins.
Lines 7-160: sequential discount positions; stop flag; better-than-previous replacement; DIRE relations; order-total and internal discounts skipped; agreement discount not included (TODO).
Repo design doc for the price calculator; may lag code.

Product/design intent: DSP Price subscribes to M3 key tables and provides price simulation outside M3 (avoids OIS320MI cost/limits); for ecommerce + customer price list tools. Campaign special case CMNO→CSYTAB. Not deployment proof.
Historical 2021 API/APIM naming context. Uncertain for current env names; not proof of current get-prices topology.

Documents consumer/MDM unit multiplicationFactor semantics (inverted under Price unit for Flisekompaniet/Optimera) and known Pricer Plaza/returns issues; DSP assumes SalesPriceUnit=NOBBPriceUnit. NOT evidence of in-process PriceCalculator topology or internals.

uncertainties: dsp-price copy has no .git; evidence identified by per-file sha256.
docs/PriceCalculator.md may lag code; code is authoritative.
Confluence 22777574 v6 (simulate prices outside M3) is product intent; parity with M3 OIS320MI not verified.
Unit-conversion and future-price-override resolvers are not drilled further.
New nested layer id: auto-layout on first open; no dsp-arch-pos carryover; existing parent ids/positions unchanged.

nodes.label: Context resolution
nodes.responsibility: Gate + defaults: customer must be allowed and match tenant; fills division/facility/currency/order type/warehouse defaults; price-list table and discount model come from the customer. N-MONTER is redirected to N-MONTERX (VAT workaround). Missing items/item masters/control matrix -> no prices.

uncertainties: Agreement selection and address validation are TODO in code (lines 52-57); agreements do not affect price-list choice today.

nodes.label: Price-list matrix role
nodes.responsibility: Control matrix (OIS831) defines, per priority position, which field set selects a price list. Table resolution tries a direct match, then customer chain levels (most specific first) with wildcards, keeping the best match per position and the latest price per limit/campaign.

sources.note: Lines 15-30: OIS831 control matrix by price-list table.
Lines 17-125: per priority: direct match first, then chain levels 9->down with wildcard; first best QueryOrder; latest ValidFrom per limit/campaign.

nodes.label: Gross price role
nodes.responsibility: Tenant-specific rule picks which resolved list counts as gross (Dahl prio>=9 then named BDBR_9A; Optimera/Flisekompaniet/Monter prio 1; DahlFI prio 9; OptimeraSE first found). No/zero gross -> no price.

sources.note: Lines 196-205 and 351-397: per-tenant gross price list (Dahl prio>=9 then BDBR_9A; Optimera/Flisekompaniet/Monter prio 1; DahlFI prio 9; OptimeraSE first found); gross<=0 -> no price.

uncertainties: OptimeraSE/Dahl gross rules are explicitly band-aid in code comments.

nodes.label: Discount role
nodes.responsibility: Discount numbers (model + currency) select discount values via chain/priority, exact matches only; positions apply sequentially with stop/replace relations. NetPriceUsed prices skip discounts. Agreement discounts not included.

sources.note: Lines 15-30: discount numbers from discount model + currency.
Lines 17-120: discounts by model date, priority and chain resolution; exact matches only (no wildcards, line 98).
Lines 7-160: sequential discount positions; stop flag; better-than-previous replacement; DIRE relations; order-total and internal discounts skipped; agreement discount not included (TODO).

nodes.label: Best-price selection
nodes.responsibility: Across price lists: computes campaign/limit and volume-limit prices (cheapest per required quantity kept) and selects the lowest net price as the regular price; adds order-total discount (limit<=1).

sources.note: Lines 207-299: per price list, campaign/limit prices with per-campaign discounts; line volume-discount limits; keep cheapest per quantity; best net price wins.
Lines 301-320 and 334-348: NetPriceUsed skips discounts; order-total discount (limit<=1); result with campaign/limit prices and future overrides used.

nodes.label: Direct-delivery variant
nodes.responsibility: Optional second pass with direct-delivery line/order type for non-Dahl tenants when requested and permitted and the item is a direct-delivery product.

sources.note: Lines 155-186: direct-delivery price recalculated with direct-delivery line/order type when tenant != Dahl, requested and customer allowed, and item is direct-delivery.
